blocks.text: Tennis world number one Jannik Sinner has brought a premature end to his season due to a knee injury, the Italian announced on Tuesday. “Me, together with the doctors, have decided that I need a course of treatment for my knee, which means that the 2026 season is officially over,” Sinner said in a video posted on social media. The 25-year-old’s announcement came just over a month before he was due to defend his crown at the ATP Finals in Turin.
